title: Drake Music Disc
description: Add new music discs containing Iceman, Maid Of Honour, and HABIBTI.
body:
This mod adds new music discs featuring Drake's three latest albums: Iceman, Maid Of Honour, and HABIBTI.

Use this mod in singleplayer mode or on your server with your friends to enjoy this amazing music.

Drake GOAT 👑
